ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Registry Persistence Attempt Via DbgManagedDebugger
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the addition of the "Debugger" value to the "DbgManagedDebugger" key in order to achieve persistence. Which will get invoked when an application crashes Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\\\\\.NETFramework\\\\DbgManagedDebugger$") AND  NOT (Details = "\"C\:\\Windows\\system32\\vsjitdebugger\.exe\"\ PID\ \%d\ APPDOM\ \%d\ EXTEXT\ \"\%s\"\ EVTHDL\ \%d")
